description:
Garda Capital Partners (Garda) is a multi-billion dollar alternative investment firm with over 22 years of experience deploying relative value strategies across fixed income markets for institutional investors. We hire, grow, and mentor great talent and remain steadfast in our commitment to building a culture that helps them succeed. Garda is more than a workplace. We are built on trust, integrity, and a shared vision for how we work together, the enduring relationships we build, and the consistency of our results. Garda's primary offices are located in Wayzata, New York City, West Palm Beach, Geneva, Zug, Copenhagen, Singapore, and Scottsdale. 

 Garda is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to own Platform Engineering & Automation. This hands-on role builds and operates shared deployment capabilities for infrastructure and selected applications, while providing advanced infrastructure engineering and production support.

 The engineer develops reusable deployment pipelines, infrastructure templates, and self-service workflows that help teams provision environments and release changes consistently — working with architecture, application owners, and regional teams to improve platform reliability and resolve complex infrastructure problems.

 Position Responsibilities 

 Escalation & Infrastructure Support

 
 Serve as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents and recurring operational problems

 Troubleshoot across Windows/Linux systems, identity, networking, cloud, virtualization, storage, and backup

 Lead root-cause analysis and convert recurring incidents into engineering work or documented standards

 Participate in major changes, recovery events, and follow-the-sun handoffs

 
 Platform Engineering & Deployment Automation

 
 Build automation using PowerShell, Python, and APIs with production-quality testing and error handling

 Own reusable infrastructure-as-code and configuration templates (Terraform, Ansible)

 Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and applications, including validation, environment promotion, health checks, and rollback

 Apply Git, peer review, automated tests, change controls, and secure secrets handling

 
 Observability, Reliability & Standards

 
 Improve monitoring, logging, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and automated health checks

 Tune operational signals to reduce noise and improve detection/recovery

 Maintain reusable provisioning workflows and self-service capabilities

 Own platform reliability and lifecycle improvements with service owners

 
 Technical Leadership

 
 Mentor engineers and workplace technology staff in troubleshooting and automation practices

 Review infrastructure code and pipeline designs with architecture, Security, and application owners

 Maintain runbooks, diagrams, and onboarding guidance

 Maintain a prioritized platform backlog with the architect and regional leads

 
 Qualifications & Desired Skills 

 
 4–6 years of hands-on infrastructure operations experience across several domains

 Degree in IT, computer science, computer engineering, or a related field

 Advanced PowerShell or Python automation experience, including API integration

 Practical experience with infrastructure as code or configuration management

 Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines (Git, testing, secure deployment, rollback)

 Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and incident-response skills

 Working knowledge of monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability concepts

 Ability to document work, mentor others, and collaborate across a distributed team

 
 Preference for experience with:

 
 AWS, container platforms, modern cloud operating patterns (Azure a plus)

 Experience delivering reusable provisioning workflows for infrastructure and business applications

 Familiarity with ITSM, change, incident, and problem-management practices

 Experience in financial services or another performance-sensitive environment

 Track record of solving complex infrastructure problems and building shared capabilities other teams can use independently

 Strong track record of maintaining high standards for reliability, documentation, and maintainability

 Experience remaining effective under pressure, with a history of mentoring and knowledge-sharing within teams

 
 Candidate Privacy Notice 
 This role is also eligible for other forms of compensation and benefits, such as a discretionary bonus, healthcare plan, 401(k) matching program, etc. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education.

 Base Salary for this role is expected to be between:
 $135,000 — $165,000 USD
